mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.2% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicate robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 0.5% in 1 month, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% over 3 months indicates supply-side expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days in high industrial production regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth > 0.5% in 3 months, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent 3-month growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% indicates supply-driven expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% in 3 months, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 1-year average supports strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 1-year average, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days in high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
